description_en: Creates a new agent session and returns the session ID
description_zh: 创建一个新的Agent会话并返回会话ID
name: CreateAgentSession

parameters.help_en: The request ID passed by the caller. The value is returned as-is
parameters.help_zh: 请求方传入的 id，原样回显
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en:
The name of the agent bound to the session. This parameter is required.
dataworks_data_agent: DataWorks built-in agent — Data Agent, which provides intelligent data development AI capabilities covering the entire workflow of data integration, development, O&M, governance, and analytics.
dataworks_chatbi_agent: DataWorks built-in agent — ChatBI, which uses natural language processing and intelligent analytics technologies to automate the entire analysis workflow from requirement parsing, data extraction, and automatic code generation to visualization report output through conversational interaction.
dataworks_ai_assistant_agent: DataWorks built-in agent — AI Assistant Service, which is a DataWorks enterprise-grade dedicated AI assistant built on open source frameworks such as OpenClaw and Hermes Agent
fields.help_zh:
会话绑定的 Agent 名称，必填
dataworks_data_agent ： DataWorks系统内置智能体 (Agent) — Data Agent，覆盖数据集成、开发、运维、治理与分析全链路的智能化数据开发AI能力
dataworks_chatbi_agent ： DataWorks系统内置智能体 (Agent) — ChatBI，基于自然语言处理与智能分析技术，通过对话交互实现从需求解析、数据抽取、代码自动生成到可视化报告输出的全流程自动化分析
dataworks_ai_assistant_agent ： DataWorks系统内置智能体 (Agent) — AI助理服务，基于OpenClaw、Hermes Agent等开源框架构建的DataWorks企业级专属AI助理
fields.name: agent_name

fields.help_en: The agent configuration for the session. Valid values are the results returned by the ListAgents operation
fields.help_zh: 该会话运行的Agent配置，取值范围是ListAgents接口返回的结果
fields.name: agent

fields.help_en: The session source identifier for retrieval by source. For example, if an agent is used on both page A and page B, and you want page A to display only sessions created from page A, you can filter based on this parameter. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
fields.help_zh: 会话来源标识，便于按来源检索。比如Agent可以在A页面使用，也可以在B页面进行使用，此时如果有需求需要在A页面只展示A页面创建出来的Session，就可以基于该参数进行过滤。长度不超过128位，支持英文字母+数字+中划线+下划线组合
fields.name: session_source

fields.help_en: The session tag. You can filter sessions based on session tags. For example, if you use a fixed RAM user to call OpenAPI operations but your calling system has its own account system, you can pass the account ID of your calling system as this tag to filter the session list by account ID. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
fields.help_zh: 会话标签。可以基于会话标签进行过滤，比如调用OpenAPI的时候用的是固定的RAM子账号，但是调用系统中有自己的账号体系，此时需要基于账号ID过滤Session列表，该标签就可以传调用系统的账号ID。长度不超过128位，支持英文字母+数字+中划线+下划线组合
fields.name: session_tag_code

fields.help_en: The list of session tags. You can use session tags for search and filtering
fields.help_zh: 会话标签列表，后续可以基于会话标签进行搜索过滤
fields.name: session_tags

fields.help_en: The session parameter settings, such as filtering parameter settings based on session source and session tags
fields.help_zh: Session配置参数，比如基于Session来源、Session Tag的过滤参数配置
fields.name: config

fields.help_en:
The exec mode. Valid values:
chat: conversation mode only. Suitable for simple Q&A scenarios. Advantages: fast response and low token consumption. Disadvantages: cannot handle complex problems.
cli: sandbox mode. Suitable for complex data analytics, data processing, and code writing scenarios. Advantages: can handle complex problems with the model autonomously performing analysis and problem resolution. Disadvantages: slower processing speed and higher token consumption compared to chat mode
fields.help_zh:
执行模式：
chat：仅对话模式，适合简单的问数、答疑的场景，优点是快、token消耗低，缺点是无法处理复杂问题
cli：沙箱模式，适合复杂的数据分析、数据处理、代码编写等场景，优点是能够处理复杂问题，模型自主进行分析和问题处理等，缺点是相对于chat模式处理速度慢，token消耗较高
fields.name: execution_lane

fields.help_en:
The authorization mode for script execution. OpenAPI currently supports only the yolo mode. Valid values:
yolo: automatic authorization. No human intervention is required, and the model can process tasks automatically
fields.help_zh:
脚本执行的授权模式（OpenApi目前仅支持yolo模式）：
yolo：自动授权，无需人为介入，模型可以自动处理
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The ID of the resource group used for initialization
fields.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The names of custom skills to load. Separate multiple names with commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 加载的自定义skill名称，多个用英文逗号相隔
fields.name: skills

fields.help_en: The advanced parameter settings for the agent execution environment
fields.help_zh: Agent执行环境的高级参数设置
fields.name: initial_config_options

fields.help_en: The extended metadata that carries agent binding, session source, tags, and other information
fields.help_zh: 扩展元信息，承载 agent 绑定、会话来源、标签等
fields.name: meta

Id.description_en: The request ID passed by the caller. The value is returned as-is
Id.description_zh: 请求方传入的 id，原样回显

Result.description_en: The business data. The value is null if an error occurs
Result.description_zh: 业务数据；出错时为 null

SessionId.description_en: The ID of the created session
